aetherium.vulkan.switch.title: Aetherium needs Vulkan
aetherium.vulkan.switch.message: The game is running on OpenGL, so shader packs and Aetherium's GPU features are off. Switch the Graphics API to Vulkan and quit? It takes effect the next time you start the game.
aetherium.vulkan.failed.title: Vulkan could not start
aetherium.vulkan.failed.message: The Graphics API is set to Vulkan, but it could not start on this PC, so the game fell back to OpenGL. Shader packs and Aetherium's GPU features are off. Updating the graphics driver usually fixes this.

modmenu.descriptionTranslation.aetherium: Shader packs on Minecraft's Vulkan renderer. Runs standard-format shader packs natively, with shader-engine and memory optimisations, a searchable pack screen, hold-to-zoom and a centred crosshair.
fml.menu.mods.info.description.aetherium: Shader packs on Minecraft's Vulkan renderer. Runs standard-format shader packs natively, with shader-engine and memory optimisations, a searchable pack screen, hold-to-zoom and a centred crosshair.
aetherium.settings.title: Aetherium Settings
aetherium.settings.help: Click to change · right-click or Shift+scroll to go back · middle-click resets · Enter applies · hold Tab to look at the world
aetherium.settings.help_search: Results from every page. Esc clears the search.
aetherium.settings.banner.restart: Restart the game to finish applying: %s
aetherium.settings.banner.opengl: Running on OpenGL: shader packs and GPU optimisations need Vulkan (Video Settings › Graphics API).
aetherium.settings.toast.page_at_default: Everything on this page is at its default
aetherium.settings.toast.apply_failed: Could not apply %s · details in the log
aetherium.settings.value.lod_hidden: Hidden: the pack has no LOD support
aetherium.settings.value.api_needs_vulka: %s · set Graphics API to Vulkan in Video Settings
aetherium.settings.page.shaders.title: Shaders
aetherium.settings.page.shaders.subtitle: Shader packs and the shader engine
aetherium.settings.page.hud.title: HUD
aetherium.settings.page.hud.subtitle: Zoom, its readout and the crosshair
aetherium.settings.page.advanced.title: Advanced
aetherium.settings.preset.recommended.de: Every optimisation at its recommended value: experiments off, everything else on.
aetherium.settings.preset.off.name: All off
aetherium.settings.preset.off.descriptio: Turns every optimisation off: plain vanilla behaviour, for comparing or for tracking down a problem.
aetherium.settings.shader_packs.name: Shader packs
aetherium.settings.shader_packs.descript: Choose a shader pack, change its options and see the result live. Drop pack zips onto that screen to install them.
aetherium.settings.shader_active.name: Active pack
aetherium.settings.shader_active.descrip: The pack in use and its state.
aetherium.settings.shader_key.name: Shortcuts
aetherium.settings.shader_key.descriptio: Keys in game: open the shader pack screen, turn shaders on and off, reload the pack from disk (unbound at first). Change them under Controls › Key Binds.
aetherium.settings.lod.status.name: Far terrain (LOD mod)
aetherium.settings.lod.status.descriptio: How the LOD mod's far terrain is drawn with the current pack. Its own options are in its own menu.
aetherium.settings.shaders.shadow_distan: How far the shadow map reaches, in chunks: rewrites the pack's own shadowDistance before its shaders are built, so its filtering stays matched. Shorter is sharper and cheaper. Pack: the pack's value. Reloads the pack.
aetherium.settings.shaders.shadow_map_sc: The shadow map's size as a share of what the pack asks for: rewrites the pack's own shadowMapResolution before its shaders are built, so its filtering stays matched. Lower is faster with softer, coarser shadows. Reloads the pack.
Draws the world, the pack's passes and the hand at this share of the window, then upscales the picture with FSR 1.0 before the interface (which stays sharp). Lower is faster in heavy packs; 100% is off. The shadow map has its own setting.
aetherium.settings.shaders.upscale_sharp: How strongly the upscaled picture is sharpened, on FSR's own scale: 0 is the strongest, each 1.00 halves it. The default is 0.20.
aetherium.settings.zoom.key.name: Zoom key
aetherium.settings.zoom.key.description: Hold it in game to zoom; the scroll wheel sets how far while held. Change it under Controls › Key Binds.
aetherium.settings.zoom.sensitivity.name: Zoomed sensitivity
aetherium.settings.zoom.sensitivity.desc: How fast the mouse turns the view while zoomed. At 100% a mouse movement moves the picture as far across the screen at any zoom as it does unzoomed; lower is slower and steadier.
aetherium.settings.zoom.cinematic.name: Cinematic camera
aetherium.settings.zoom.cinematic.descri: Smooths the mouse while zoomed, as the game's cinematic camera does: gliding turns, slower to aim. Off: the view follows the mouse directly.
aetherium.settings.zoom.nominal.name: Starting zoom
aetherium.settings.zoom.nominal.descript: The magnification every zoom starts at; scrolling changes it until the key is let go.
aetherium.settings.zoom.min.name: Least zoom
aetherium.settings.zoom.min.description: How far out the scroll wheel goes while zoomed. 1.0× is the normal view.
aetherium.settings.zoom.max.name: Most zoom
aetherium.settings.zoom.max.description: How far in the scroll wheel goes while zoomed. Below the least zoom, the least zoom is used.
aetherium.settings.zoom.corner.name: Readout corner
aetherium.settings.zoom.corner.descripti: The screen corner the zoom's panels sit in.
aetherium.settings.zoom.coordinates.name: Coordinates panel
aetherium.settings.zoom.coordinates.desc: While zoomed: the block coordinates of what the crosshair is on, how far away it is and the direction you face.
aetherium.settings.zoom.target.name: Target panel
aetherium.settings.zoom.target.descripti: While zoomed: a 3D preview and the name of the block or mob the crosshair is on.
aetherium.settings.crosshair.centred.des: Moves the crosshair onto the exact centre of the window, where the camera points. The game rounds its position down, which leaves it a pixel or more left of and above the centre at most window sizes.
aetherium.settings.profile.name: Optimisation profile
aetherium.settings.profile.description: Recommended: every optimisation at its default. Baseline: everything off, the reference the benchmarks measure against. Switching resets the per-optimisation choices.
aetherium.settings.reset_all.name: Reset Aetherium settings
aetherium.settings.reset_all.description: Puts every Aetherium setting on this screen back to its default (vanilla options are not touched). Apply to keep it.
aetherium.settings.open_config.name: Config folder
aetherium.settings.open_config.descripti: Opens the folder that holds aetherium.json.
aetherium.settings.open_logs.name: Logs folder
aetherium.settings.open_logs.description: Opens the game's log folder (latest.log has Aetherium's start-up report).
aetherium.settings.clear_shader_cache.de: Deletes the converted shader code kept on disk (aetherium/shader-cache). The next load of each pack converts its programs again.
aetherium.settings.bench.gpu_timers.name: GPU timers
aetherium.settings.bench.gpu_timers.desc: Benchmark runs measure GPU time per frame with timestamp queries. Only used by the benchmark harness.
aetherium.settings.bench.pass_timers.des: Benchmark runs also time each render pass. Only used by the benchmark harness.
aetherium.settings.sys.api.name: Graphics API
aetherium.settings.sys.api.description: The renderer the game is running on. Aetherium's GPU work and shader packs need Vulkan.
aetherium.settings.sys.gpu.name: GPU
aetherium.settings.sys.driver.name: Driver
aetherium.settings.sys.cpu.name: CPU threads
aetherium.settings.sys.cpu.description: Logical processors available to the game; chunk building and world generation use them.
aetherium.settings.sys.cpu.description_s: Java only sees %s of this PC's %s threads (Windows processor groups), so chunk building uses half the CPU. Add -XX:+UseAllWindowsProcessorGroups to the game's JVM arguments in your launcher.
aetherium.settings.sys.memory.name: Memory
aetherium.settings.sys.memory.descriptio: Memory the game may use (set with -Xmx in your launcher) and how much is in use now.
aetherium.settings.opt.mem.state_cache_d: Block states share identical collision shapes and face data instead of each keeping its own copy (6,000 shape objects become about 330).
aetherium.settings.opt.mem.component_pat: Item data that has been emptied again shares one empty table instead of keeping an empty copy per item.
Chunk storage detects cross-thread misuse with a single number instead of a lock object per section (about 13 MB at 16 chunks render distance).
aetherium.settings.opt.shaders.lean_fram: Skips the depth copies, conversions and clears that the loaded pack never reads. About 3% faster with packs; the picture is identical.
aetherium.settings.opt.shaders.shadow_ca: Keeps the terrain part of the shadow map between frames and redraws it only when the sun has moved a fiftieth of a degree, you move to another spot or a chunk changes, so terrain shadows can trail the sun by that much; mobs and players still cast shadows every frame. Up to 16% faster with shadow-heavy packs.
aetherium.settings.opt.shaders.early_han: Draws your hand and held items together with the world, so packs that light the scene afterwards light them too. Off: the hand stays unlit (full bright) in those packs.
aetherium.settings.opt.shaders.nan_prese: Keeps packs' checks for invalid pixel values working on Vulkan, as they do on OpenGL. Without it some packs (FastPBR) turn the screen black. Applies when a pack loads.
aetherium.settings.opt.shaders.inline_co: Records packs' compute programs into the frame's own command list instead of splitting it for each group of them. The picture is identical.
aetherium.settings.opt.gpu.pipeline_cach: Keeps compiled GPU pipelines on disk (aetherium/pipeline-cache.bin) so the next launch and shader pack loads can start faster. Ignored automatically after a driver or GPU change. How much time it saves is not measured yet.
aetherium.settings.opt.shaders.reach_sna: Each world pass copies only the pack buffers that the shaders able to draw in it can actually read, instead of every buffer any of them mentions. The picture is identical.
aetherium.settings.opt.shaders.settled_b: Works out each pack shader's textures once per render pass and re-binds only what changed; per draw only the texture's own material maps follow it. Helps most with many mobs on screen. The picture is identical.
aetherium.settings.opt.shaders.frozen_fu: The pack's full-screen passes keep their texture plan from load and upload their settings in one go per stage instead of one at a time. The picture is identical.
aetherium.settings.opt.shaders.cpu_matri: Terrain shaders read the frame's normal and inverse view matrices instead of working them out for every vertex and pixel. Applies when a pack loads.
aetherium.settings.opt.shaders.hw_shadow: Packs' shadow-map comparisons use the GPU's built-in depth-comparison filtering (one lookup) instead of four lookups and a blend in the shader, as OpenGL does it. Faster with shadow-heavy packs; shadows look the same.
aetherium.settings.opt.shaders.blit_mips: Fills packs' blurred copies of their buffers (bloom, exposure) and mipmapped shadow maps with direct image copies instead of one draw pass per level, and only when the buffer changed. On wide screens the chains now go down to a single pixel as on OpenGL.
aetherium.settings.opt.shaders.loadop_cl: Packs' per-frame buffer clears happen as the first pass that draws into each buffer starts, and the rest together in one go, instead of one separate clear (and GPU stall) per buffer. The picture is identical.
aetherium.settings.opt.shaders.narrow_ba: After each of the shader engine's own passes the GPU waits only for what that pass wrote, instead of for all of its memory. The game's own passes are unchanged. The picture is identical.
aetherium.settings.opt.shaders.flip_only: Gives a pack's buffer its second (ping-pong) copy only when a pass writes or swaps it. Saves video memory; the amount is in the log. Applies when a pack loads or the window is resized.
aetherium.settings.opt.shaders.shadow_ca: When the shadow cache is reused and nothing is drawn on top of it, packs read the cached shadow map directly instead of copying it back first. The picture is identical.
aetherium.settings.opt.shaders.zero_loca: Pack shader variables that are read before they are written start at zero, as OpenGL drivers give them. Without it some packs show black faces or flickering lines on Vulkan. Only the variables that need it are touched.
aetherium.settings.opt.shaders.transform: Keeps each pack program's converted shader code on disk (at most 256 MiB), so loading the same pack again skips most of the conversion work. Anything that changes the result (pack options, settings, an Aetherium update) makes a new entry. Tools has a button to clear it.
